name: @wapplersystems/form-build
description: Build pipeline for the wapplersystems/form editor JavaScript (TypeScript -> ESM).

scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run rewrite && npm run deploy

comment: node_modules is symlinked to ../../../../source/Build/node_modules during development (reuse of the TYPO3 monorepo toolchain & @typo3/* type surface). Making this build fully self-contained is a later step (see plan V0 'Vollständiger Plan').
